name: Utakata
source:
Main character falls asleep in the train, misses his station and decides to take a day off from college. There are mountains close to the empty station, so goes to climb the nearest mountain. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
